cultures.title: Galungan
description: A festival of victory over adversity, held every 210 days on the Balinese pawukon calendar.

cultures.title: Kuningan & Mekotek
description: The day of reflection ten days after Galungan, when the ancestors return to the heavens.

cultures.title: Nyepi
description: Bali's Day of Silence, when the island stops, the lights go out and the sky fills with stars.

cultures.title: Melasti
description: A cleansing procession to the sea, a few days before Nyepi.

cultures.title: Ogoh-ogoh
description: Giant demon figures paraded through the streets on the eve of Nyepi.

cultures.title: Piodalan
description: The birthday of a temple, celebrated with offerings, music and dance.

cultures.title: Bali Art Festival
description: Bali's month-long celebration of dance, music and craft, held each summer in Denpasar.

cultures.title: Perang Pandan & Ayunan Jantra
description: A ritual duel with thorny leaves in an ancient village in eastern Bali.

cultures.title: Purnama & Tilem
description: The full moon and new moon, the most sacred days of the Balinese month.

cultures.title: Offerings
description: Small daily gifts of flowers, rice and incense, set out in homes, shops and temples.

offers.title: Beach Wedding & Honeymoon
description: A small ceremony on the sand, a candlelit dinner and two nights to enjoy it.

offers.title: Slow Stay
description: Three unhurried days with breakfast, transfers and nothing you have to do.

offers.title: Stay & Dine
description: A stay built around a tasting table for two at Kemuning Kitchen.

offers.title: Cooking Class
description: Shop at the morning market, then cook a Balinese lunch with our chefs.

offers.title: Craft Corner
description: A small boutique of homewares, textiles and books from Bali makers.

menuList.title: Breakfast
description: From warm bread and tropical fruit to coconut-sugar pancakes and Balinese rice porridge, served until late morning on the terrace.

menuList.title: All-day dining
description: Home-style Indonesian cooking and a few international favourites, made with produce from nearby farms and the early fish market.

menuList.title: Drinks & wine
description: Fresh juices, cold-pressed coconut water, local coffee, classic cocktails and a short, well-chosen wine list for the sunset hour.

diningOffers.title: Sunset Supper
paragraphs: Every evening the tables move to the sand and the lanterns come out.
Choose a three-course set menu of grilled fish, slow-cooked curries and a tropical dessert.

diningOffers.title: Afternoon Tea
paragraphs: A quiet pot of tea with sweet and savoury Indonesian snacks on a three-tier stand, served in the garden pavilion.

diningOffers.title: Indonesian Tasting Table
paragraphs: Many small dishes arrive together around a bowl of rice: grilled fish, braised beef, eggs, vegetables and relishes, each with its own flavour and texture.

diningOffers.title: Beach Table for Groups
paragraphs: Reserve a long table on the sand for birthdays, reunions and family dinners, with a shared menu of home-cooked dishes.

diningOffers.title: Candlelit Beach Dinner
paragraphs: A private table at the water's edge, set with tropical flowers and candles.
Four courses are served with a bottle of house wine.

diningIntro.title: Kemuning Kitchen
diningIntro.description: Eat in the open-sided pavilion, or at a table in the sand beneath the trees. Our kitchen cooks Indonesian home cooking and a few international favourites with produce from nearby farms and the early fish market. Open daily from 7 am to 10 pm.
